lenders.name: Open Bank
lenders.footprint: CA-centric Korean-American bank; SBA loans also made out of state (e.g. Texas motel refinance example)
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a) (mostly variable rate), Commercial real estate
lenders.broker_program: No published broker or referral program found. Filings say SBA loans go mainly to small manufacturing, wholesale, retail, hotel/motel and service businesses, and that the bank sells the 75% guaranteed portion. Ask the SBA desk whether it pays Form 159 referral fees.
lenders.fit_notes: An LA SBA 7(a) lender that names hotels/motels as a core SBA segment. Its lending page shows a $2.775M SBA 7(a) refinance of an independent LA County motel. SBA portfolio was $253.7M at 12/31/2024. Broker channel unconfirmed.

lenders.name: GBank
lenders.parent_or_aka: GBank Financial Holdings Inc. (GBFH); formerly Bank of George
lenders.footprint: National SBA lending in 42 states (per 2026 investor presentation)
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a), USDA B&I
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. GBank says it is the leading originator of hotel SBA loans in the US (#1 hotel SBA lender per SBALenders.com, March 2023) and originated over $550M of 7(a) loans in 2025. GoSBA ranks it #1 for 2025 hotel/motel SBA 7(a) volume (~$432M). Confirm whether it pays Form 159 referral fees.
lenders.fit_notes: Largest hotel SBA 7(a) lender in the US by 2025 volume, so it is a must-call for hotel 7(a) deals. Its 42-state list was not seen, so California lending is unconfirmed.

lenders.name: CBB Bank
lenders.parent_or_aka: Commonwealth Business Bank; CBB Bancorp, Inc. (OTCQX: CBBI)
lenders.footprint: CA-based; 10 branches, 3 regional SBA offices, 5 loan production offices
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a), Commercial real estate
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. An SBA data tracker shows 980 SBA 7(a) approvals totaling $1.25B from FY2020 to Q1 FY2026. Ask the SBA regional offices about Form 159 referral fees.
lenders.fit_notes: CBB Bank and Commonwealth Business Bank are the same bank, so it has one record here. A high-volume Korean-American SBA 7(a) lender in LA. Hotel share not confirmed in sources found.

lenders.name: PCB Bank
lenders.parent_or_aka: Pacific City Bank; PCB Bancorp (NASDAQ: PCB)
lenders.footprint: LA-based; SBA 7(a) loans funded in 37 states (per PeerSense)
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a) (PLP)
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. SBA Preferred Lender (PLP). Trackers show 702 7(a) loans / $905.6M (FY2020 to Q1 FY2026); another tracker says 3,007 loans. Best Western franchise borrowers appear in its SBA data. Confirm Form 159 referral-fee policy with the SBA desk.
lenders.fit_notes: A large Korean-American SBA PLP lender in LA with Best Western franchisees among its borrowers. Hotel-specific program not documented in sources found.

lenders.name: Celtic Bank
lenders.footprint: National (business development officers nationwide)
lenders.property_types: Hospitality (hotel acquisition, construction), Owner-occupied CRE, Small business
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a), SBA 504 / CDC, USDA B&I, SBA CAPLines ($500k-$5M)
lenders.broker_program: Has a documented referral partner program: Celtic 'works with loan brokers, business consultants, and relationship managers' and 'offers referral fees to qualified partners', with a dedicated business development officer for each partner. Approved partners can send deals right away. SBA PLP lender.
lenders.fit_notes: A national SBA PLP lender with a published broker channel and over 20 years of hotel acquisition and construction lending (per NerdWallet/Biz2Credit). Hotel-specific terms not published.

lenders.name: Newtek Bank
lenders.parent_or_aka: NewtekOne, Inc. (NASDAQ: NEWT); Newtek Bank, N.A.; formerly Newtek Small Business Finance
lenders.footprint: National
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a) (PLP), SBA 504 (via affiliate), Conventional business loans
lenders.broker_program: Has a referral program for lenders and other referral sources that send loans Newtek can take (per a third-party review). Newtek is a top-2 national SBA 7(a) lender and has had PLP authority since April 2023. Hotel-specific referral terms not found. Confirm the Form 159 fee policy.
lenders.fit_notes: A national top-tier SBA 7(a) lender with a known referral channel. A good fallback for hotel 7(a) deals that CA community banks decline. Hotel focus not documented.

lenders.name: US Metro Bank
lenders.footprint: CA-chartered; SBA lending also outside CA
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a), USDA, Commercial real estate, C&I
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. GoSBA's 2025 FOIA ranking puts US Metro #2 nationally for hotel/motel SBA 7(a) volume (~$190M), and the Korea Herald ranked it #10 among Korean-American SBA lenders (FY2026). OCBJ says it specializes in small-business and franchisee loans. Confirm Form 159 referral-fee policy.
lenders.fit_notes: An Orange County Korean-American bank that ranks second nationally for hotel SBA 7(a) volume. A top call for SoCal hotel 7(a) deals. Broker channel not documented.

lenders.name: Bank of Hope
lenders.footprint: National Korean-American bank; SBA 7(a) loans funded in all states (per PeerSense)
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a), SBA 504, SBA Express (to $350k), Export Working Capital, EZ loans (non-SBA)
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. Its SBA page lists 7(a), 504, Export Working Capital and Express. The Korea Herald ranked it #6 among Korean-American SBA lenders (FY2026). Ask the SBA desk about Form 159 referral fees for hotel deals.
lenders.fit_notes: The largest Korean-American bank in the US and a major SBA 7(a)/504 lender headquartered in LA. Hotel-specific program not published, and no broker channel documented.

lenders.name: Herring Bank - Hospitality Lending
lenders.footprint: Says it serves hotel owners across the US; marketing is focused on TX, OK, CO (2025 expansion)
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a), SBA 504, Conventional hotel loans, Hotel CMBS, Construction, Refinance, Franchise financing
lenders.broker_program: No broker program found. Its hospitality unit has an online preliminary application.
lenders.fit_notes: A dedicated hotel lending group with SBA, CMBS and construction products. Mostly a Texas, Oklahoma and Colorado lender, so CA reach is unconfirmed.

lenders.name: Live Oak Bank - Hospitality
lenders.footprint: National
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a), SBA 504, Conventional hotel acquisition and refinance
lenders.broker_program: Pays referral sources an agreed fee on eligible closed, fully funded loans under a standard referral agreement. For SBA loans the referral source and borrower sign Form 159, and the fee is paid no later than 30 days after month-end (per a hosted Live Oak referral document). SBA PLP lender.
lenders.fit_notes: Other desk of Live Oak Bank (already listed for senior care). Its dedicated hospitality team does SBA and conventional hotel loans nationally and has a documented referral-fee process. Referral fee percentage not published.

lenders.name: Millennium Bank
lenders.footprint: Multi-state SBA hotel lending (24-25 states per SBA data trackers)
lenders.property_types: Hospitality (Super 8, Comfort Inn, Motel 6 and other franchised hotels)
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a) (PLP)
lenders.broker_program: No broker program found. Coleman Report named it 2025 SBA Hospitality Lender of the Year and says it has been a leading SBA 7(a) hotel lender for 15 years. Trackers show 245 7(a) loans / $531.1M (FY2020 to 2025).
lenders.fit_notes: An SBA 7(a) hotel specialist, which suits franchised limited-service hotel deals. Ask whether it lends in CA and pays Form 159 referral fees. HQ state (IL) is from a third-party tracker.

lenders.name: Driftwood Lending Partners
lenders.parent_or_aka: Driftwood Capital (hotel investment, development and lending firm)
lenders.footprint: National (deals in TX, FL and other states)
lenders.programs: Hotel mezzanine loans, Preferred equity, Mezz for refinance/recap and ground-up development
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. Its lending fund gives mezz and pref equity on existing and ground-up hotels, e.g. a $30M mezz in June 2025 behind a Sheraton Dallas refinance and a $12.1M mezz loan. Over $690M of financings by late 2022. Driftwood is also a borrower and developer (e.g. its Mission Valley, San Diego extended-stay construction).
lenders.fit_notes: A hotel-only mezz/pref equity source for gaps in hotel bridge, PIP and construction stacks. CA lending not documented, though Driftwood develops in San Diego. Verify HQ and CA appetite.

lenders.name: HALL Structured Finance
lenders.footprint: National
lenders.programs: Hotel ground-up construction (1st lien), Hotel bridge, Construction for multifamily
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. Its CA hotel construction loans include the Park James Hotel in Menlo Park ($26M, 2017), the Andaz in Palm Springs ($55M, 2017), Cambria Suites in Napa and Sonoma ($42M), the Aloft in Glendale ($17.6M, 2018), the Hampton Inn in Watsonville ($23M, 2018) and the Hyatt House in Sacramento (2019). Still active in 2025-2026: Dellshire Resort WI ($41.1M) and Orem Circle Apts ($37M, Feb 2026).
lenders.fit_notes: Has a long record of 1st-lien construction loans on CA select-service and boutique hotels, so it is a core construction call for CA hotel ground-up. The CA hotel deals found are 2017-2019. Confirm current CA hotel appetite and broker terms.

lenders.name: First General Bank
lenders.footprint: SoCal-based; SBA loans in 8 states (per PeerSense)
lenders.property_types: Hospitality (Motel 6, Quality Inn, Best Western franchisees), CRE
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a) (PLP), Interim construction loans, CRE, Trade finance
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. PeerSense lists it as SBA PLP, with its highest SBA franchise volume in Motel 6, Quality Inn and Best Western. The FDIC CRA report notes interim construction lending and a loan book that is about 97% real estate.
lenders.fit_notes: A Chinese-American SGV bank (about $1.1B in assets) doing SBA 7(a) and construction loans for franchised economy hotels. Fits CA motel/hotel 7(a) and small hotel construction. Broker channel unconfirmed.

lenders.name: Wallis Bank
lenders.footprint: TX-founded (1906); markets include Houston, Dallas, San Antonio, Los Angeles, Atlanta, Phoenix
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a), SBA 504, SBA hotel construction, Conventional acquisition, construction/development, Working capital lines
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. SBA Preferred Lender ranked in the top 50 nationally. A 2023 ProjectionHub analysis names it the leading SBA hotel construction lender, with 54 hotel construction approvals averaging about $3.07M. Has a Los Angeles market presence.
lenders.fit_notes: An SBA hotel construction specialist with an LA presence. It fits ground-up limited-service hotel 7(a)/504 construction in CA. Ranking data is from 2023, and the broker channel is unconfirmed.

lenders.name: United Midwest Savings Bank
lenders.parent_or_aka: UMWSB; SBA brand Midwest Business Capital
lenders.footprint: National: says it lends to businesses in all 50 states; recorded mortgages most active in OH, FL, CA (Elementix)
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a) (loans over $150k), Conventional hotel loans, Hospitality financing
lenders.broker_program: Has a broker landing page (simplefinancing-dev.umwsb.com/brokers, seen on a dev subdomain). Its hospitality FAQ says it is 'a national bank, not a broker' and calls itself 'one of the largest SBA lenders in the country with a specialty in hospitality'. Confirm the broker fee policy.
lenders.contact_title: Hospitality financing (listed on umwsb.com hospitality page; title not captured)
lenders.fit_notes: A national SBA lender focused on hotels, with heavy recorded-mortgage activity in CA and an apparent broker page. A strong fit for hotel 7(a) acquisitions and refinances.

lenders.name: T Bank
lenders.footprint: National SBA team
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a), SBA 504 (PLP)
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. Its lending page describes a national SBA team (PLP) doing 7(a) and 504. ZoomInfo lists a $7.674M SBA 504 IHG hotel loan.
lenders.fit_notes: A Dallas SBA PLP bank with national reach and hotel 504 activity. CA lending and broker channel unconfirmed. The phone number is from ZoomInfo.

lenders.name: Hanmi Bank - SBA Lending
lenders.footprint: LA-based; SBA program in a nationwide expansion (2025-2026)
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a) (Preferred Lender)
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. FY2024 SBA volume was $187M (+25%), and 1H2025 production rose 18% year on year. GoSBA ranks it #40 nationally in 2025 ($181M, 214 loans). Hotel share not broken out. Ask about Form 159 referral fees.
lenders.fit_notes: Other desk of Hanmi Bank (already listed for construction). Its SBA 7(a) desk is a natural fit for Corin's hotel 7(a) deals in LA. Hotel focus and broker channel unconfirmed.

lenders.name: Cathay Bank - SBA Lending
lenders.footprint: SBA 7(a) loans in 17 states (per PeerSense); CA core
lenders.property_types: Hospitality (Best Western, Motel 6 franchisees), Owner-occupied CRE, Small business
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a), SBA 504 (real estate, construction, equipment, acquisition, refinance)
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. Its SBA page offers 7(a) and 504 for real estate purchase, construction and refinance. It has been an SBA PLP lender since 1999 (third-party review). PeerSense lists 1,099 7(a) loans averaging $474K, with Best Western and Motel 6 among its top franchise concepts.
lenders.fit_notes: Other desk of Cathay Bank (already listed for construction). Its SBA 7(a)/504 desk has a record of lending to motel and hotel franchisees in CA. Broker channel unconfirmed.

lenders.name: Arena Investors
lenders.parent_or_aka: Arena Investors, LP (Arena Real Estate Partners)
lenders.footprint: National
lenders.programs: Bridge loans, Special situations, Pre-development / land bridge, 1st mortgage
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. Arena runs a bridge-loan business and describes a niche, complex-situations strategy. Its CA deals include bridge financing for a planned boutique hotel in St. Helena (Napa Valley) that paid off a maturing land loan and funded pre-development, and a $27M 1st mortgage on a California retail plaza (Oct 2023).
lenders.fit_notes: A special-situations bridge lender for hard hotel deals, such as maturing debt, pre-development or entitlement bridges in CA. Not hotel-only. Broker channel and HQ not confirmed in sources found.

lenders.name: Thomas Financial Group
lenders.parent_or_aka: Community Bankshares Inc. (LaGrange, GA) subsidiary; affiliates Community Bank & Trust, Phoenix Lender Services; capital partner Siguler Guff
lenders.footprint: National (USDA B&I; CA hotel deals 2025)
lenders.programs: Hotel bridge-to-USDA B&I, USDA Business & Industry loans, Hospitality bridge loans
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. 2025 deals include a $13.9M bridge (with Siguler Guff) refinanced by a $14.3M USDA B&I loan for the National Exchange Hotel (Nevada City) and the Holbrooke Hotel (Grass Valley), a $19.975M USDA B&I loan for two historic Mendocino hotels, and three hospitality bridge loans totaling over $34M closed in under 40 days (May 2025).
lenders.fit_notes: An active 2025 lender on CA boutique and rural hotels through bridge-to-USDA structures. It fits non-urban CA hotel acquisitions and renovations that are outside SBA limits. Broker terms unknown.

lenders.name: Mission Valley Bank
lenders.footprint: San Fernando / Santa Clarita Valley CA base; SBA loans in 36 states (per PeerSense)
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a) (Preferred Lender since 2007), SBA real estate purchase and refinance, Equipment, Debt restructuring
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. Trackers show 286 7(a) loans / $477.4M (FY2020 to 2025). Hotel loans not confirmed.
lenders.fit_notes: An LA-area SBA PLP community bank and a possible smaller 7(a) outlet for CA motel deals. No hotel-specific evidence found, so it is only partly relevant.

lenders.name: Hotel.Bank
lenders.parent_or_aka: Ownership not confirmed. Says it was 'created by hotel bankers, owners and operators'. First Bank of the Lake (fblake.bank, already in directory) publishes hotel-loan articles alongside it.
lenders.footprint: Not stated
lenders.property_types: Hospitality (stabilized hotels; acquisitions, refinance, renovation, construction)
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a), SBA 504, Conventional hotel acquisition/refinance (24-mo I/O product)
lenders.broker_program: No broker program found. Origination fee is 1% or 1.25% (conventional).
lenders.fit_notes: Possibly another desk of First Bank of the Lake, which is unconfirmed, so verify ownership before adding. It is hotel-only with published conventional terms (up to $15M, 75% LTV) plus SBA 7(a)/504. CA lending and broker channel unconfirmed.

lenders.name: Woori America Bank
lenders.footprint: SBA loans in 13-18 states; top markets CA, TX, NJ, NY, VA
lenders.property_types: Owner-occupied CRE, Small business, Franchise businesses
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a)
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. GoSBA ranks it #94 nationally in 2025 ($74.2M, 95 loans), with California as its heaviest market. Top franchise concepts are restaurants, and no hotel data was found.
lenders.fit_notes: A Korean-American SBA lender whose largest SBA market is CA. Hotel appetite unconfirmed, so it is a secondary 7(a) outlet.

lenders.name: Arriba Capital
lenders.footprint: National (CA, TN, FL and others)
lenders.programs: Hotel ground-up construction, Hotel construction take-out / refinance (non-recourse)
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. Deals include a $40.5M ground-up construction loan for a Home2 Suites + Courtyard in Woodland, CA (June 2022), a $67M Nashville dual-brand, a $52.5M hotel construction loan, a $35.75M Florida hotel, and The Scoundrel (July 2025).
lenders.fit_notes: A dedicated hotel construction lender with a CA dual-brand loan at 80% LTC, which fits Corin's hotel construction line. HQ and broker terms not found in the sources.

lenders.name: CIM Real Estate Debt Solutions
lenders.parent_or_aka: CIM Group (lending platform for CIM-managed funds)
lenders.footprint: National (major US markets)
lenders.programs: Hotel bridge whole loans, Construction loans, Mezzanine, Acquisition + renovation
lenders.broker_program: No published broker program found. In May 2026 CIM closed $154M of hotel loans: a $63M whole-loan refinance of the 192-room Monterey Beach Hotel (CA), a $56M loan on the Kimpton Monaco Pittsburgh, and $35M for the Sheraton Suites Fort Lauderdale West (acquisition/renovation). It began its hospitality lending push in 2023.
lenders.fit_notes: An LA-based platform making large-balance hotel bridge loans, including a 2026 CA coastal hotel refinance. Best for $30M+ hotel bridge/PIP deals. CIM's former SBA unit (PMC) was sold to Peachtree, so that is a separate business. HQ is from CIM Group's public profile.

lenders.name: First Internet Bank - SBA Lending
lenders.footprint: National SBA team (all industries nationwide)
lenders.property_types: Owner-occupied CRE, Franchise businesses, Small business
lenders.programs: SBA 7(a) (Preferred Lender)
lenders.broker_program: Its SBA origination runs on referral partners and brokers. Press releases describe BDOs who serve 'clients and referral partners', one with ties to business and real estate brokers. A job posting says associates source deals 'through a network of referral sources and brokers'. The bank calls itself a top-10 SBA 7(a) lender (2023). Fee terms not published.
lenders.fit_notes: A national SBA PLP lender built around a broker channel, which suits 7(a) hotel franchise acquisitions. Hotel appetite not documented, so ask before sending motel or hotel files.
